content_sections.heading: About DMFT Chatra Medical Officer
content_sections.text: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand issued this recruitment notice for the District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Chatra. The DMFT will engage Medical Officers on a contractual basis at various health facilities under DMFT Chatra. According to the notice, the DMFT is floating these vacancies to strengthen the health sector of the district. The notice is signed by the Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, DMFT, Chatra.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice has 15 Medical Officer posts. The table below shows how these posts are divided by category. The notice defines these categories as per the Government of Jharkhand, and the Government of Jharkhand's reservation policy applies. Jharkhand candidates who claim reservation in their category (ST, SC, BC-I, BC-II) must submit the latest caste certificate in the prescribed format. This certificate must be issued by the competent authority of Jharkhand State. EWS candidates must attach the latest income certificate issued by the Govt. of Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must have valid medical registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council. The candidate should not have been convicted by any court of law. Candidates who are currently employed must enclose a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, if applicable, as listed on the application form. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the Medical Officer post, see the official notification.

rows.qualification: MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) with valid registration

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: A Medical Officer receives ₹ 75000/ Month (Consolidated, full-time). The notice does not name any other allowance. TDS will apply as per Government rules. Salary and choice of posting are non-negotiable and rest purely with the selection committee, Chatra. The service is purely contractual for a period of one year and is a full-time role. Successful candidates must execute the one-year contractual agreement. The contract may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance. No claim for regularisation of the position will be entertained. Performance will be reviewed after completion of three months of service. Continuation depends on satisfactory performance during the probation period. If performance is unsatisfactory, the probation period may be extended by one to three months, as the competent authority deems appropriate. Either party may terminate the contract by giving one-month prior notice. Services may also be terminated if performance is not satisfactory. Leave is availed according to the provisions of the State Government. Selected doctors must serve full-time in the posted health institution. They will be posted as per requirement in any block or health institution of Chatra district. If the Government of Jharkhand or the Department of Health, Medical Education & Family Welfare, Jharkhand deploys Medical Doctors in Chatra district in the near future, the post will be dissolved and the contract terminated.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMFT Chatra Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the recruitment section of the official website https://chatra.nic.in/ or from the Office of the DMFT, Chatra. The form is also printed on pages 5 and 6 of the notice. Fill in the form and paste a self-attested photograph. Then sign the declaration. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Write "Application for the Post of Medical Officer under DMFT, Chatra" clearly on the envelope. Submit the application by hand or send it by Registered Post/Speed Post to: The Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, 2nd Floor, District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand – 825401. The application must reach the office by 18/11/2026, till 05:00 PM. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. The hiring process is a personal interview, and marks obtained in the interview are the criteria for selection. The interview date will be notified on the official website of Chatra district, https://chatra.nic.in/ . Candidates must bring the printout of the application form, all original documents/certificates and one set of self-attested copies to the interview. Candidates who do not bring these will not be allowed to appear in the interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation certificate (as proof of age) MBBS degree certificate and marksheets PG degree certificate and marksheet (if available) Registration certificate with valid registration with NMC / State Medical Council Experience certificate(s), if any Latest Caste certificate (for reserved category candidates) issued by Govt. of Jharkhand Latest Income certificate (for EWS category candidates) issued by Govt. of Jharkhand Recent passport-size photograph (signed across) Aadhaar Card The note on the application form also lists the following: Intermediate marksheets and certificates, a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer (if applicable), a Domicile Certificate, and any other document that explains the candidate's experience. Self-attested copies of these must be enclosed with the application and brought on the day of the interview. Printout of the offline application form All educational marksheets (year wise) and certificates (Matriculation and MBBS) PG Degree Marksheet and Certificate (if available) Proof of age (Matriculation certificate) Aadhaar Card and recent passport-size photograph Registration certificate issued by NMC / State Medical Council Experience certificate, if available (Govt. or Private Institutions) Latest Caste certificate and Latest Income certificate, if applicable (issued by Govt. of Jharkhand) Any other relevant certificate/testimonial/letter of recognition or appreciation

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer vacancies are in DMFT Chatra Recruitment 2026??
faq.answer: There are 15 Medical Officer posts: Gen 7, SC 2, ST 1, OBC 2, BC 2 and EWS 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DMFT Chatra Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office by 18 November 2026, till 05:00 PM. Applications received after this deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for DMFT Chatra Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) with valid registration. Experience is not mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a DMFT Chatra Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹ 75000/ Month (Consolidated, full-time). Salary is non-negotiable.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DMFT Chatra Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed form with self-attested documents by hand or by Registered Post/Speed Post to The Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, 2nd Floor, District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand – 825401.

faq.question: Q6. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be clearly superscribed "Application for the Post of Medical Officer under DMFT, Chatra".

faq.question: Q7. How will DMFT Chatra Medical Officers be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a personal interview, and marks obtained in the interview are the criteria for selection. The interview date will be notified on https://chatra.nic.in/.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DMFT Chatra Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The job is purely contractual for one year and full-time, and it may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance. No claim for regularisation will be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates who applied earlier need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says candidates who applied earlier will have to apply again for the position.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
